purpose: Describe an expected action as difficult to make happen.
keywords: The bus is taking ages to come.
I cannot seem to remember this kanji.
I am so busy that I can hardly take a break.
restrictions: Often implies that progress is slower or harder than hoped.
mistake: Positive なかなか can instead praise something as quite good.
